result.brief: 提出解耦漂移-扩散世界模型：用高斯NLL联合回归确定性下一帧与空间异方差不确定性图，并以该图作为条件扩散的空间门控，在机器人操作与相机运动两类动作空间上提升未来帧预测一致性。
result.reason: Action-conditioned future frame prediction world model with learned uncertainty-gated diffusion; directly a video world model contribution, though not a representation/tokenizer contribution.
